assertions.evidence: Multiple markdown tables with pipe delimiters and header rows present, including 'Shipping Cost Calculation' and 'Overnight Availability' tables with properly formatted headers separated by dashes.

assertions.text: Express shipping is split into at least two cases distinguishing the UK free tier (UK, order £50+, free) from the paid tier
assertions.evidence: Table clearly shows 'Express — at free threshold, UK | Express | £50 | UK | £50 | £0.00' (free) versus 'Express — at free threshold, outside UK (no free tier) | Express | £50 | {Ireland, EU} | £50 | £9.99' (paid), demonstrating the UK-specific free threshold.

assertions.text: Express rows use value sets to consolidate cases with the same outcome — not enumerated as separate rows per order value when the result is identical
assertions.evidence: Row 4 'Express — at free threshold, UK | £50 | £0.00' and Row 5 'Express — above free threshold, UK | £75 | £0.00' are separate rows despite identical outcomes. Similarly, Row 6 'Express — at free threshold, outside UK | £50 | {Ireland, EU} | £9.99' and Row 7 'Express — above free threshold, outside UK | £75 | {Ireland, EU} | £9.99' are separate rows. These should be consolidated using value sets like {£50, £75} rather than enumerated separately.

assertions.text: Overnight UK and Ireland are in one row using a value set ({UK, Ireland}) — not separate rows
assertions.evidence: Overnight Availability table shows two separate rows: 'Overnight — UK | UK | £14.99' and 'Overnight — Ireland | Ireland | £14.99'. These should be consolidated into a single row as 'Overnight | {UK, Ireland} | £14.99' since they have identical cost and availability.

assertions.text: Standard shipping destination uses a value set covering all options or is blank/absent
assertions.evidence: 'Standard — flat rate regardless of context | Standard | {£10, £100} | {UK, Ireland, EU}' shows the destination column using a value set {UK, Ireland, EU} covering all destination options.

assertions.text: At least one output column ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Both tables contain a 'Cost?' column header ending with a question mark. The first table header includes 'Cost?' and the second table also includes 'Cost?' and 'Reason?' columns.
